title: Don’t Miss Out on a Senior Mission
author: Norman C. Hill
author_role: Former Mission President, Ghana Accra West Mission

footnotes.text: Ronald A. Rasband, “How Great Will Be Your Joy,”Liahona, Nov. 2023, 53.
Russell M. Nelson, “Senior Missionaries and the Gospel,”Liahona, Nov. 2004, 81.
Russell M. Nelson, “Preaching the Gospel of Peace,”Liahona, May 2022, 7.

“Joy. Hope. Sustaining power from God. Protection from temptation. Healing. All of these—and more (including forgiveness of sins)—distill upon us from heaven as we share the gospel” (Marcus B. Nash, “Hold Up Your Light,”Liahona, Nov. 2021, 72).
